title: Rerun the 12 cad-3d, coding and embedded cases once on gemma4:12b after the key fix
goal: cad-3d/*, coding/* and embedded/* have ledger entries under the F-120-T16 source key, so later system runners no longer make them pending
acceptance: Approved by the owner's F-120-T15 decision (2026-11-26, "b"); runs in a night model plan (gauntlet:F-036), never while the owner uses the local model, in a development worktree created from origin/main after F-120-T16 merged, never ~/.nerv-app

Commands, from that worktree: node tools/gauntlet.mjs model-run --pack=coding --profile=node_modules/@voidbrain/gauntlet-protocol/examples/profiles/gemma4-12b.json --allow-models --execute --out=/private/tmp/f120-t17-coding.json && node tools/gauntlet.mjs ledger --pack=coding --report=/private/tmp/f120-t17-coding.json

node tools/gauntlet.mjs model-run --pack=embedded --only=led-blink-gpiozero-regression,pwm-servo-rpigpio-regression,button-toggle-gpiozero-holdout,edge-counter-rpigpio-holdout --profile=node_modules/@voidbrain/gauntlet-protocol/examples/profiles/gemma4-12b.json --allow-models --execute --out=/private/tmp/f120-t17-embedded.json && node tools/gauntlet.mjs ledger --pack=embedded --report=/private/tmp/f120-t17-embedded.json

node tools/gauntlet.mjs model-run --pack=cad-3d --only=spacer-cylinder-regression,l-bracket-regression,open-tray-holdout,flanged-bushing-holdout --profile=node_modules/@voidbrain/gauntlet-protocol/examples/profiles/gemma4-12b.json --allow-models --execute --out=/private/tmp/f120-t17-cad-3d.json && node tools/gauntlet.mjs ledger --pack=cad-3d --report=/private/tmp/f120-t17-cad-3d.json

Then node tools/gauntlet.mjs pending | grep -E '^(cad-3d|coding|embedded)/' prints nothing, and the ledger change goes into a PR (check:gauntlet-ledger passes). Coding cases take up to 180 s each: at most about 36 min for the 12
Until then this step names cad-3d/*, coding/* and embedded/* so check:gauntlet-runs passes
privacy: Neutral invented data only; captured replies stay private evidence, never committed.
escalation: A second run or a different model needs the owner again

effort.basis: One run of the 12 cases (at most 36 min at 180 s a case) plus the ledger PR. Not a measurement.
